remarks: Beautiful, updated townhouse is waiting for You! Upgraded throughout, you can enjoy dinner in your dining room or on your deck. The unit features a microwave in kitchen and mini fridge in your bar area, opening up to a large living room. Enjoy the fireplace centrally located between your living room, bar area, and dining room. The upper level boasts a large primary bedroom with three closets and an entertainment center built in. The secondary bedroom has two closets. The full-sized washer & dryer laundry is located on the upper level along with an updated bathroom. Ring doorbell and patio camera provides an extra level of security - Hardwood floors - attic storage - Reserved parking space #102/Visitor parking spaces Enjoy the flowers and beautifully landscaped grounds - and during warmer months, relax by the in-ground pool. Make plans to see it today! Agents submit application, proof-of-income and full credit report w/score for all adults that will occupy the property. NO PETS
